name: Vector Topology Analysis
aliases: Vector Topology Analysis — Critical point classification
definition: A technique to analyze vector field topology based on critical point classification to capture global features of a flow field.
summary: Vector Topology Analysis identifies zero-magnitude points, classifies them via Jacobian eigenvalues, and traces a streamline skeleton to reveal global flow structures, differing from advection or glyph methods by focusing on singularities rather than arbitrary paths or local samples.
